gloss: capital city of king Bela in Edom
definition: דִּנְהָ֑בָה proper name, of a location capital city of king Bela in Edom Gen 36:32 = 1Chr 1:43 identification with Tennib (perhaps = Thenib , near the edge of the Belka, east-northeast from Heshbon, described by Tristr Moab 222 ) by Neubauer Acad. 1891, 260 compare Tomkins ib. 284 . דָּנִיֵּאל see דָּנִאֵל below דין . דֵּעַ , דֵּעָה see below ידע . (רְעוּאֵל) דְּעוּאֵל see below ידע , רעה .
definition_html:
BDB1985 [H1838]

BDB1984 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB1986

דִּנְהָ֑בָה proper name, of a location capital city of king Bela in Edom Gen 36:32 = 1Chr 1:43 identification with Tennib (perhaps = Thenib, near the edge of the Belka, east-northeast from Heshbon, described by TristrMoab 222) by NeubauerAcad. 1891, 260 compare Tomkinsib. 284.

דָּנִיֵּאל see דָּנִאֵל below דין.

דֵּעַ, דֵּעָה see below ידע.

(רְעוּאֵל) דְּעוּאֵל see below ידע, רעה.
